title: एकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 61 · Dhritarashtra asks about the Jayadratha day

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks what the grieving Pandavas and Kauravas did at dawn after Abhimanyu's death. He blames his own foolish partiality and says no one can speak against Krishna's side.
summary.kn: ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯುವಿನ ಸಾವಿನ ನಂತರ ದುಃಖಿತ ಪಾಂಡವ-ಕೌರವರು ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರೆಂದು ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತನ್ನ ಮೂರ್ಖ ಪಕ್ಷಪಾತವನ್ನು ದೂಷಿಸಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪಕ್ಷದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಯಾರೂ ಮಾತನಾಡಲಾರರೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र पूछते हैं कि अभिमन्यु की मृत्यु के बाद शोकाकुल पाण्डवों और कौरवों ने भोर में क्या किया। वे अपने मूर्खतापूर्ण पक्षपात को दोष देते हैं और कहते हैं कि कृष्ण के पक्ष के विरुद्ध कोई नहीं बोल सकता।
summary.te: అభిమన్యుని మరణం తరువాత దుఃఖితులైన పాండవ కౌరవులు ఉదయం ఏం చేశారని ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడుగుతాడు. తన మూర్ఖపు పక్షపాతాన్ని నిందించుకుని కృష్ణుని పక్షానికి ఎవరూ వ్యతిరేకంగా మాట్లాడలేరంటాడు.
summary.ta: அபிமன்யு இறந்தபின் துயருற்ற பாண்டவரும் கௌரவரும் விடியலில் என்ன செய்தனர் என்று த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்கிறான். தன் மடமை பக்கச்சார்பைப் பழித்து, கண்ணனின் பக்கத்துக்கு எதிராக எவரும் பேச முடியாது என்கிறான்.
summary.ml: അഭിമന്യുവിന്റെ മരണശേഷം പ്രഭാതത്തിൽ ദുഃഖിതരായ പാണ്ഡവരും കൗരവരും എന്തു ചെയ്തുവെന്ന് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. സ്വന്തം മൂഢമായ പക്ഷപാതത്തെ അദ്ദേഹം കുറ്റപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു; കൃഷ്ണന്റെ പക്ഷത്തിനെതിരെ ആർക്കും സംസാരിക്കാനാവില്ലെന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.61; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
श्वोभूते किमकार्षुस्ते दुःखशोकसमन्विताः ।
अभिमन्यौ हते तत्र के वायुध्यन्त मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: Tomorrow came, and what did they do, burdened with sorrow and grief? After Abhimanyu was killed, who among my people fought?

verses.text:
जानन्तस्तस्य कर्माणि कुरवः सव्यसाचिनः ।
कथं तत्किल्बिषं कृत्वा निर्भया ब्रूहि मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the deeds of Savyasachin, how, tell me, did my Kurus, having committed that wrong, stay fearless?

verses.text:
पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं क्रुद्धं मृत्युमिवान्तकम् ।
आयान्तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं कथं ददृशुराहवे ॥

meaning.en: How did they see in battle that tiger among men, burning with grief for his son, angry like Death the ender, as he came?

verses.text:
कपिराजध्वजं संख्ये विधुन्वानं महद्धनुः ।
दृष्ट्वा पुत्रपरिद्यूनं किमकुर्वन्त मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the one with the monkey-king banner in battle shaking his great bow, in distress over his son, what did my people do?

verses.text:
किं नु संजय संग्रामे वृत्तं दुर्योधनं प्रति ।
परिदेवो महानत्र श्रुतो मे नाभिनन्दनम् ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, what happened in the battle in Duryodhana's case? I hear a great lament, not any rejoicing.

verses.text:
बभूवुर्ये मनोग्राह्याः शब्दाः श्रुतिसुखावहाः ।
न श्रूयन्तेऽद्य ते सर्वे सैन्धवस्य निवेशने ॥

meaning.en: The sounds that were pleasing to the mind and delightful to the ear are not heard today in Saindhava's quarters.

verses.text:
स्तुवतां नाद्य श्रूयन्ते पुत्राणां शिबिरे मम ।
सूतमागधसंघानां नर्तकानां च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: In my sons' camp I hear no sound today of the praises from groups of charioteers, bards and dancers all around.

verses.text:
शब्देन नादिताभीक्ष्णमभवद्यत्र मे श्रुतिः ।
दीनानामद्य तं शब्दं न शृणोमि समीरितम् ॥

meaning.en: The noise that used to fill my ear constantly, I hear no longer today; the voices are those of the dejected.

verses.text:
निवेशने सत्यधृतेः सोमदत्तस्य संजय ।
आसीनोऽहं पुरा तात शब्दमश्रौषमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, long ago, sitting in the house of the steadfast Somadatta, I heard splendid sounds.

verses.text:
तदद्य हीनपुण्योऽहमार्तस्वरनिनादितम् ।
निवेशनं हतोत्साहं पुत्राणां मम लक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Unlucky as I am, today I see that house, which resounds with cries of distress, its spirit broken, and my sons' houses likewise.

verses.text:
विविंशतेर्दुर्मुखस्य चित्रसेनविकर्णयोः ।
अन्येषां च सुतानां मे न तथा श्रूयते ध्वनिः ॥

meaning.en: Such a sound is no longer heard from Vivimshati, Durmukha, Chitrasena, Vikarna and my other sons.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या यं शिष्याः पर्युपासते ।
द्रोणपुत्रं महेष्वासं पुत्राणां मे परायणम् ॥

meaning.en: The great archer, son of Drona, whom brahmins, kshatriyas and vaishyas attend as students, the refuge of my sons,

verses.text:
वितण्डालापसंलापैर्हुतयाचितवन्दितैः ।
गीतैश्च विविधैरिष्टै रमते यो दिवानिशम् ॥

meaning.en: who delights day and night in disputations and talk, in offerings, requests and praises, in songs of many kinds he likes,

verses.text:
उपास्यमानो बहुभिः कुरुपाण्डवसात्वतैः ।
सूत तस्य गृहे शब्दो नाद्य द्रौणेर्यथा पुरा ॥

meaning.en: attended by many Kurus, Pandavas and Satvatas: charioteer, the sound in Drona's son's house today is not as before.

verses.text:
द्रोणपुत्रं महेष्वासं गायना नर्तकाश्च ये ।
अत्यर्थमुपतिष्ठन्ति तेषां न श्रूयते ध्वनिः ॥

meaning.en: The singers and dancers who attend Drona's son, the great archer, are not heard any more.

verses.text:
विन्दानुविन्दयोः सायं शिबिरे यो महाध्वनिः ।
श्रूयते सोऽद्य न तथा केकयानां च वेश्मसु ॥

meaning.en: The great din heard at evening in Vinda and Anuvinda's camp is not so today, nor in the houses of the Kekayas.

verses.text:
नित्यप्रमुदितानां च तालगीतस्वनो महान् ।
नृत्यतां श्रूयते तात गणानां सोऽद्य न ध्वनिः ॥

meaning.en: The great sound of beating time and singing from the always-merry troops of dancers is not heard today.

verses.text:
सप्ततन्तून्वितन्वाना यमुपासन्ति याजकाः ।
सौमदत्तिं श्रुतनिधिं तेषां न श्रूयते ध्वनिः ॥

meaning.en: The sound of the son of Somadatta, the storehouse of learning, whom sacrificers attend as they spread the seven strands, is not heard.

verses.text:
ज्याघोषो ब्रह्मघोषश्च तोमरासिरथध्वनिः ।
द्रोणस्यासीदविरतो गृहे तन्न शृणोम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: In Drona's house the bowstring sound, the Vedic chant, and the noise of spears, swords and chariots used to be unending, and I do not hear it now.

verses.text:
नानादेशसमुत्थानां गीतानां योऽभवत्स्वनः ।
वादित्रनादितानां च सोऽद्य न श्रूयते महान् ॥

meaning.en: The great sound of songs from many lands and of sounding instruments is not heard today.

verses.text:
यदा प्रभृत्युपप्लव्याच्छान्तिमिच्छञ्जनार्दनः ।
आगतः सर्वभूतानामनुकम्पार्थमच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: Ever since Janardana, wishing peace, came from Upaplavya out of compassion for all beings,

verses.text:
ततोऽहमब्रुवं सूत मन्दं दुर्योधनं तदा ।
वासुदेवेन तीर्थेन पुत्र संशाम्य पाण्डवैः ॥

meaning.en: I said to the foolish Duryodhana then, charioteer, "Son, make peace with the Pandavas through Vasudeva, the path to it."

verses.text:
कालप्राप्तमहं मन्ये मा त्वं दुर्योधनातिगाः ।
शमे चेद्याचमानं त्वं प्रत्याख्यास्यसि केशवम् ।
हितार्थमभिजल्पन्तं न तथास्त्यपराजयः ॥

meaning.en: "I think the time has come. Do not cross the line, Duryodhana. If you refuse Keshava when he begs for peace, you will not avoid defeat, for he speaks for your good."

verses.text:
प्रत्याचष्ट स दाशार्हमृषभं सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
अनुनेयानि जल्पन्तमनयान्नान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: He rejected the Dasharha, bull among all archers, while he spoke persuasively, and did not take it up, going the wrong way.

verses.text:
ततो दुःशासनस्यैव कर्णस्य च मतं द्वयोः ।
अन्ववर्तत हित्वा मां कृष्टः कालेन दुर्मतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then, abandoning me, drawn by Time, the evil-minded one followed the opinion of Duhshasana and Karna alone.

verses.text:
न ह्यहं द्यूतमिच्छामि विदुरो न प्रशंसति ।
सैन्धवो नेच्छते द्यूतं भीष्मो न द्यूतमिच्छति ॥

meaning.en: I did not want the dice game, Vidura did not praise it, Saindhava did not want it, and Bhishma did not want it.

verses.text:
शल्यो भूरिश्रवाश्चैव पुरुमित्रो जयस्तथा ।
अश्वत्थामा कृपो द्रोणो द्यूतं नेच्छन्ति संजय ॥

meaning.en: Shalya, Bhurishravas, Purumitra, Jaya, Ashvatthama, Kripa and Drona did not want the dice game, Sanjaya.

verses.text:
एतेषां मतमाज्ञाय यदि वर्तेत पुत्रकः ।
सज्ञातिमित्रः ससुहृच्चिरं जीवेदनामयः ॥

meaning.en: If my son had acted knowing their opinion, he would have lived long, free of sickness, with his kinsmen, friends and well-wishers.

verses.text:
श्लक्ष्णा मधुरसंभाषा ज्ञातिमध्ये प्रियंवदाः ।
कुलीनाः संमताः प्राज्ञाः सुखं प्राप्स्यन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: The Pandavas, gentle and sweet-spoken, who speak kindly among their kin, well-born, respected and wise, will find happiness.

verses.text:
धर्मापेक्षो नरो नित्यं सर्वत्र लभते सुखम् ।
प्रेत्यभावे च कल्याणं प्रसादं प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: A man who always looks to dharma finds happiness everywhere, and after death attains good and grace.

verses.text:
अर्हन्त्यर्धं पृथिव्यास्ते भोक्तुं सामर्थ्यसाधनाः ।
तेषामपि समुद्रान्ता पितृपैतामही मही ॥

meaning.en: They deserve to enjoy half the earth, for they have the strength and means. Even for them it is the earth of their fathers and grandfathers, bounded by the sea.

verses.text:
नियुज्यमानाः स्थास्यन्ति पाण्डवा धर्मवर्त्मनि ।
सन्ति नो ज्ञातयस्तात येषां श्रोष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: If told, the Pandavas will stay on the path of dharma. We have kinsmen whose words the Pandavas will heed, my son.

verses.text:
शल्यस्य सोमदत्तस्य भीष्मस्य च महात्मनः ।
द्रोणस्याथ विकर्णस्य बाह्लिकस्य कृपस्य च ॥

meaning.en: Shalya, Somadatta, the great-souled Bhishma, Drona, Vikarna, Bahlika and Kripa,

verses.text:
अन्येषां चैव वृद्धानां भरतानां महात्मनाम् ।
त्वदर्थं ब्रुवतां तात करिष्यन्ति वचो हितम् ॥

meaning.en: and other great-souled elder Bharatas, speaking for your sake, my son, will do what is helpful.

verses.text:
कं वा त्वं मन्यसे तेषां यस्त्वा ब्रूयादतोऽन्यथा ।
कृष्णो न धर्मं संजह्यात्सर्वे ते च त्वदन्वयाः ॥

meaning.en: Whom among them do you think would tell you otherwise? Krishna would not abandon dharma, and they are all your own kin.

verses.text:
मयापि चोक्तास्ते वीरा वचनं धर्मसंहितम् ।
नान्यथा प्रकरिष्यन्ति धर्मात्मानो हि पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: I too told those heroes words in accord with dharma, and the Pandavas, righteous as they are, will not act otherwise.

verses.text:
इत्यहं विलपन्सूत बहुशः पुत्रमुक्तवान् ।
न च मे श्रुतवान्मूढो मन्ये कालस्य पर्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: So, charioteer, I lamented and told my son many times, but the fool did not listen to me. I think it is the turn of Time.

verses.text:
वृकोदरार्जुनौ यत्र वृष्णिवीरश्च सात्यकिः ।
उत्तमौजाश्च पाञ्चाल्यो युधामन्युश्च दुर्जयः ॥

meaning.en: Where Vrikodara and Arjuna are, and the Vrishni hero Satyaki, the Panchala Uttamaujas and the unconquerable Yudhamanyu,

verses.text:
धृष्टद्युम्नश्च दुर्धर्षः शिखण्डी चापराजितः ।
अश्मकाः केकयाश्चैव क्षत्रधर्मा च सौमकिः ॥

meaning.en: and the unassailable Dhrishtadyumna, the unconquered Shikhandin, the Ashmakas, the Kekayas, Somaki, who follows kshatriya dharma,

verses.text:
चैद्यश्च चेकितानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभुः ।
द्रौपदेया विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः ।
यमौ च पुरुषव्याघ्रौ मन्त्री च मधुसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: Chaidya, Chekitana, the son of the Kashi king, Abhibhu, the sons of Draupadi, Virata, the great chariot-warrior Drupada, the two tigers among men, the twins, and Madhusudana as counsellor,

verses.text:
क एताञ्जातु युध्येत लोकेऽस्मिन्वै जिजीविषुः ।
दिव्यमस्त्रं विकुर्वाणान्संहरेयुररिंदमाः ॥

meaning.en: who in this world, wishing to live, would fight these foes, who are able to use divine weapons and to withdraw them?

verses.text:
अन्यो दुर्योधनात्कर्णाच्छकुनेश्चापि सौबलात् ।
दुःशासनचतुर्थानां नान्यं पश्यामि पञ्चमम् ॥

meaning.en: I see no one fifth, besides Duryodhana, Karna, Shakuni Saubala and Duhshasana as the fourth.

verses.text:
येषामभीशुहस्तः स्याद्विष्वक्सेनो रथे स्थितः ।
संनद्धश्चार्जुनो योद्धा तेषां नास्ति पराजयः ॥

meaning.en: There is no defeat for those whose reins are held by Vishvaksena, standing on the chariot, with Arjuna armed as the fighter.

verses.text:
तेषां मम विलापानां न हि दुर्योधनः स्मरेत् ।
हतौ हि पुरुषव्याघ्रौ भीष्मद्रोणौ त्वमात्थ मे ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana would not recall my laments. You tell me that the two tigers among men, Bhishma and Drona, are slain.

verses.text:
तेषां विदुरवाक्यानामुक्तानां दीर्घदर्शिनाम् ।
दृष्ट्वेमां फलनिर्वृत्तिं मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the outcome of the words spoken by Vidura, far-sighted as he is, I think my sons grieve now.

verses.text:
हिमात्यये यथा कक्षं शुष्कं वातेरितो महान् ।
अग्निर्दहेत्तथा सेनां मामिकां स धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: As at winter's end a great fire driven by the wind burns dry grass, so will that Dhananjaya burn my army.

verses.text:
आचक्ष्व तद्धि नः सर्वं कुशलो ह्यसि संजय ।
यदुपायात्तु सायाह्ने कृत्वा पार्थस्य किल्बिषम् ।
अभिमन्यौ हते तात कथमासीन्मनो हि वः ॥

meaning.en: Tell us all of it, for you are skilled, Sanjaya. When you came back at evening after wronging Partha, my dear, what were your minds when Abhimanyu was killed?

verses.text:
न जातु तस्य कर्माणि युधि गाण्डीवधन्वनः ।
अपकृत्वा महत्तात सोढुं शक्ष्यन्ति मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: My people will never be able to bear the great harm done to the Gandiva archer in battle.

verses.text:
किं नु दुर्योधनः कृत्यं कर्णः कृत्यं किमब्रवीत् ।
दुःशासनः सौबलश्च तेषामेवं गते अपि ।
सर्वेषां समवेतानां पुत्राणां मम संजय ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, what did Duryodhana say to do, what did Karna, Duhshasana and Saubala say, though matters stood so, among all my assembled sons?

verses.text:
यद्वृत्तं तात संग्रामे मन्दस्यापनयैर्भृशम् ।
लोभानुगतदुर्बुद्धेः क्रोधेन विकृतात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, tell me what took place in the battle through the poor policy of that fool, whose bad mind followed greed and whose self was warped by anger,

verses.text:
राज्यकामस्य मूढस्य रागोपहतचेतसः ।
दुर्नीतं वा सुनीतं वा तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय ॥

meaning.en: who longed for the kingdom, deluded and with a mind struck by passion, whether it was ill or well advised.
